name: v0.7.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Add standalone DINOv2 model with register tokens and mask support by @eklipse2k8 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2184
* Add SAM 3.1 multiplex video tracking port by @eklipse2k8 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2185
* Accelerate exact Qwen MXFP4 verification by @YuhuaBillChen in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2106
* Add Spark-X2.5 (spark2_5 hybrid-attention text model) by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2188
* Return OpenAI segments for NeMo-alignment STT models (Parakeet/Canary) by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2189
* Run distributed SFT reductions on the CPU stream to avoid Metal GPU timeout by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2191
* Fix MiniCPM5 function-call parsing by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2190
* Check native tool calling when adding models by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2192
* Reuse shared APC prefixes, bound memory, and expose live settings by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2182
* fix(qwen3_5): transpose Qwen3.8 Conv3d patch embed to NDHWC by @Taderich73 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2186
* Add opt-in exact 8-bit Qwen verifier fusion by @tjansn in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2117
* Add TTS support for MiniCPM-o by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2193
* Add GLM-5 Next support by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2127
* Add video understanding support for Mage-VL by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2202
* Use an exact prefix for thought marker removal by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2203
* Clean up redundant and trivial tests by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2205
* Add support for PP-DocLayout V3 (MLX) by @HashNuke in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2204
* Hy4 model support by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2082
* Extract tool-calling into a dedicated tools/ package by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2208
* fix(moe_offload): match nested Experts.switch_glu path (Gemma 4) by @typemild in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2213
* Add support for Indic-OCR by @HashNuke in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2198
* Strip box markers in Glm46VMoEProcessor output by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2225
* Restore optimized MXFP4 and Q3 verification by @YuhuaBillChen in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2209
* mage_vl: remap flattened OptiQ model.* keys in sanitize by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2247
* Revert "Restore optimized MXFP4 and Q3 verification" by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2251
* Fix Mllama cross-attention masks during chunked prefill by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2249
* Optimize Gemma 4 KV-shared prefill by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2157
* aya_vision: strip response markers from generated text by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2252
* Bump version to 0.7.1 by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2253

## New Contributors
* @Taderich73 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2186
* @HashNuke made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2204
* @typemild made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2213

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1
